comment: QUESTS.md P3, Olde Evermore's elves about doing things. Each of the six walked to or turned to and talked to twice, its face asserted off the message as it is set: Thalion judging arrivals, Ninian sweeping the west path (a custom route, asserted to move and to stay on the path), Aelwen at the well (the trope, counted once), Elowen's tea cosy before Mirabel's secret and after it - where Lirien and Faelan are married - Calder at the pond, and the copyist at his desk in the Archive. Nothing here is a blush.

steps.eval: window._lines = []; window._faces = []; const add = Game_Message.prototype.add; Game_Message.prototype.add = function (t) { window._lines.push(t); return add.call(this, t); }; const sf = Game_Message.prototype.setFaceImage; Game_Message.prototype.setFaceImage = function (n, i) { if (n) window._faces.push(n + ':' + i); return sf.call(this, n, i); }; window._mark = () => { window._lines = []; window._faces = []; }; window._tropes = $gameVariables.value(2); window._blushes = $gameVariables.value(7); window._has = s => window._lines.some(l => l.includes(s));

steps.comment: Thalion, at (16,7), watching the leaves. Along row 8 and up beside him.

steps.check: [window._has('Five point eight.'), window._has('I was very moved.'), window._faces.every(f => f === 'Gen_People15:4'), $gameSelfSwitches.value([38, 9, 'A'])]
steps.label: five point eight, in his own face

steps.comment: Ninian sweeps the west path, row 13 from x 6 to 10, on a route. Asserted to move and to keep to it, then talked to where he stands.

steps.eval: window._xs = new Set(); window._ys = new Set(); window._watch = setInterval(() => { const e = $gameMap.event(13); window._xs.add(e.x); window._ys.add(e.y); }, 50)

steps.label: up and down the path out, and only on it

steps.check: [window._has('Sweeping the path out.'), window._has('Will you!'), window._faces.every(f => f === 'Gen_People16:0'), $gameSelfSwitches.value([38, 13, 'A'])]
steps.label: Ninian, delighted

steps.comment: Aelwen, singing to the well at (9,15). From the grass below her.

steps.check: [window._has('The Lay of the Chosen.'), window._has('so his verse is a rest.'), window._faces.every(f => f === 'Gen_People15:5'), $gameVariables.value(2) - window._tropes]
steps.label: THE TROPE: the elven song that takes three days
the rest, and the trope counted once

steps.comment: Elowen, at her door at (18,21). From the path beside her, before Mirabel has told anybody anything.

steps.label: before the secret: a tea cosy, and nothing else

steps.comment: Mirabel has told the secret (Map 39 event 2, self switch C).

steps.check: [window._has('She told the whole breakfast table.'), window._has('have been married since the Second'), window._has('large B'), window._faces.every(f => f === 'Gen_People15:6'), $gameSelfSwitches.value([38, 11, 'A'])]
steps.label: after it: Lirien and Faelan are married, and it is still a tea cosy

steps.comment: Calder, at the pond at (20,17). From the grass below him.
The copyist, in the Archive behind his desk at (6,9). In at the door, up the carpet, along row 8.

steps.check: [window._has('So I copy everything.'), window._has('It means the margins too.'), window._has('horse'), window._faces.every(f => f === 'Gen_People16:1'), $gameSelfSwitches.value([39, 8, 'A'])]
steps.label: the margins too, and not one word more about the horse
one trope in the whole village, and no blush
